Chapter 1220 - 31: Lin Yuan’S Future Timeline (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1220: Chapter 31: Lin Yuan’s Future Timeline (Please Subscribe)

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate smiled as he looked at Lin Yuan.

In terms of strength, he was naturally inferior to the Strongest Venerable who had suddenly emerged before him.

But he was far from being afraid, what about the Strongest Venerable? Wasn’t there one in the Xuanyin Ancient Country?

And with the Xuanyin Ancestor present, was this Galaxy Venerate really bold enough to invade the Xuanyin Ancient Country?

Now that there’s finally a chance to ruthlessly profit, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate naturally would not pass it up.

The conditions he proposed to Lin Yuan were much higher than those offered to the Da Fu Ancient Country.

After all, the latter currently had the most refined core pillars, and even without his Xuanyin Ancient Country’s refined core pillar, they still had a great chance to seize this treasure land.

Therefore, Xuanyin Venerable didn’t dare to demand too much from the Da Fu Ancient Country because the other side still had options.

But the Fierce Sun Ancient Country? Without the core pillars occupied by the Xuanyin Ancient Country, even if the strength of the Galaxy Venerate was formidable enough to match Fu Xu Venerate,

it would be meaningless, as the combined refined core pillars held by the Da Fu Ancient Country, Thunderclap Ancient Country, plus the Xuanyin Ancient Country, exceeded more than half of the total number.

"Too much."

Lin Yuan said.

"Not too much."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate was unwavering.

"At most, I can offer you fifty percent of the output."

After contemplating for a moment, Lin Yuan looked at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

"Galaxy Venerate, this is the bottom line of my Xuanyin Ancient Country."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, confident of his current importance, smiled as he spoke.

"I’ll think about it."

Lin Yuan didn’t reject outright, leaving some room for maneuver.

"Alright."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate didn’t want to push Lin Yuan too hard, knowing that if there were alternatives, dealing with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country would be more beneficial to him.

"However, more than half of the time to fight over the treasure land has already passed, and I hope the Galaxy Venerate will make a decision soon; the conditions offered by the Da Fu Ancient Country are not low."

With that, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s avatar directly dissipated.

After Su Yin Heavenly Venerate disappeared,

Red Flame Venerable emerged.

"Su Yin, this guy is simply taking advantage of the situation!"

Red Flame Venerable frowned, not to mention the eighty percent of the rare treasures produced over ten trillion years by this treasure land, as well as two prime treasure lands?

How many prime treasure lands does the Fierce Sun Ancient Country hold altogether, and to give away two just for thirty-odd core pillars?

"No choice."

Lin Yuan was equally dissatisfied at heart but knew that in this situation, offending the Xuanyin Ancient Country completely would only push them toward the Da Fu Ancient Country.

Currently, with Lin Yuan’s strength, even if he could surpass Fu Xu Venerate with full effort, it wouldn’t be a crushing victory, especially with other ancient countries watching intently.

Such as the Barbaric Wilderness Country and the Da Ling Ancient Country, which, although they didn’t have the Strongest Venerable stationed within, the hidden killing implements brought out from the ancient country could contend against a Strongest Venerable to some extent.

"Galaxy, what do you plan to do?"

Red Flame Venerable looked at Lin Yuan, who, despite being angry at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s exploitation, could only rationally agree to his terms.

At least that way, there’s a chance to compete with the Da Fu Ancient Country for this treasure land.

"Stall."

Lin Yuan said.

"Stall?"

Red Flame Venerable immediately understood Lin Yuan’s intent.

See how the situation develops before making the final decision.

After all, it involved not just this treasure land but also two other prime treasure lands belonging to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Even if the Xuanyin Ancient Country didn’t specify which two prime treasure lands, even the least of prime treasure lands produced treasures of immense value.

In fact,

Red Flame Venerable was thinking too little.

Lin Yuan’s idea of ’stalling’ was not just to see how the subsequent situation unfolded, but more importantly, to see if he could achieve another breakthrough in the next thousand years.

Currently there are only three breakthroughs that Lin Yuan valued.

One is completing the third level of "Infinite Void" cultivation.

The second is reaching the second level of the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao.

The third is stepping into the Chaos Realm.

Any of these breakthroughs could lead to a qualitative surge in Lin Yuan’s strength.

...

"Su Yin, how’s the deal going?" On the Xuanyin Ancient Country’s side, Earth Yin Venerable asked Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

"The other side with the Da Fu Ancient Country is fine, but the Fierce Sun Ancient Country... Galaxy Venerate said he’d think about it." Su Yin Heavenly Venerate replied.

"That’s normal, I would consider it too." Earth Yin Venerable wasn’t surprised.

The conditions for the deals with both major Ancient Countries were clear to them, and while they could make concessions to the Da Fu Ancient Country, for the Fierce Sun Ancient Country? No concessions would be made.

Because the Xuanyin Ancient Country was convinced that they had the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the Galaxy Venerate in their grip.

"But no matter how much they consider, as long as the Fierce Sun Ancient Country still desires this treasure land, they will have to agree to us." Earth Yin Venerable smiled.

"Indeed."

"In fact, the sudden emergence of the Galaxy Venerate is a good thing for our Xuanyin Ancient Country."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate also smiled.

If there was no Galaxy Venerate, the Da Fu Ancient Country would dominate, and even with other ancient countries joining forces, the Da Fu Ancient Country’s hope of securing this treasure land was still high.

In such a situation, the Xuanyin Ancient Country wouldn’t be able to command a high price.

Other than the Da Fu Ancient Country, other ancient countries simply wouldn’t ’buy.’

But now with the Galaxy Venerate, it instilled a sense of crisis in the Da Fu Ancient Country, prompting them to readily agree to Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s demand.

With Galaxy Venerate and Fu Xu Venerate in contention like clams and snipes, regardless of who lost or won, the Xuanyin Ancient Country would emerge the beneficiary in the end.

...

In the Chaos Void, deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with a palm-sized small cauldron floating before him.
